# faBolusGarmin — LLM guide

> Garmin (Connect IQ / Monkey C) remote for faBolus. Thin remote: it relays confirmed bolus / status /
> control commands to the iPhone host over Connect IQ. The phone owns the pump. Experimental, not
> FDA-cleared.

Thin map so it does not drift. Working guide: [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md).

- **`README.md`** — architecture and the venu3s device floor.
- **`docs/STORE-BUILDS.md`** — sideload and store `.iq` builds.
- **`docs/SECURITY.md`** — remote-bolus notes (GA-01 is open; do not call the watch gesture one of
  two confirmations).
- Contract: Monkey C `RemoteCommand` mirrors faBolus `schema/command.schema.json`. Run
  `scripts/check-schema-drift.sh` after field changes.

No `direct-pump/` or `direct-cgm/` on `main`. Sibling protocol repo is `../TandemKit`.
The phone is the authority; note anything unverified on-hardware.
